_note: German (du, lower case; German capitalisation; „…“ for quotation marks), not yet reviewed by a German speaker. The glossary is in docs/translating.md. Editor › Designs: the themes' list and its menus, the versions switch and line, the templates' keys, pictures and menus, the version sheet, and the box menus of the Bible translations' rows. A theme is a Design (the main one the Hauptdesign), a template a Vorlage, a version a Variante; the example version is the Kollekte; the built-in theme and its templates are shown as „Standard“, „Zwei Sprachen“, „Eine Sprache“ and „Bibel“.
